questions.M1: How much can truth-assisted association and edit routing change with all Gaussian parameters fixed?
questions.M2: With exactly the same selected rows, what is the extra effect of location repair, scale repair and conditional splitting?

scope: one procedural mechanism scene; no classifier training; no real-world generalization claim

pilot.geometric_association: 13 covariance support probes vs independent unedited first-hit surfaces at the query time
pilot.status: already executed exploratory sensitivity controls; not retrospectively preregistered
pilot.known_limitation: depth matching can reject the wrong-depth contaminants we need to diagnose; sparse support is not actual alphaT responsibility

main_followup.M0: Edit the original learned dynamic branch, keep all static rows
main_followup.M1_recall: Add static rows with native unified-scene sum(body-mask alpha*T) > 0.0001 pixel-weight; no depth gate or background veto
main_followup.association_meaning: conditional contribution candidate, not proof of physical object identity; original dynamic branch is inherited noisy routing
main_followup.M2_position: Same M1 candidates; move selected static means to independently observed body first-hit XYZ weighted by their actual original alpha*T
main_followup.M2_position_scale: M2 position plus fixed 0.08m max-axis cap preserving axis proportions; heuristic diagnostic, not fitted best threshold
main_followup.M2_position_scale_split: Same candidates; split contributions with both body/background alphaT into vehicle and retained-background children using separately weighted first-hit coordinates
main_followup.split_budget: at most one extra background child per triggered parent; inherited parent SH; optical-thickness fractions from original body/background weights
main_followup.split_conservation_boundary: co-located identical-footprint transmittance only; moving/shrinking children does not conserve every pixel alpha
main_followup.updated_parameters: M1 none; M2 selected static means/scales and split child opacity; original dynamic and environment frozen
main_followup.parameter_only_delete_control: Moving or shrinking rows that are subsequently fully deleted must yield the same delete RGB; only a retained split child can change this control

evidence_and_holdout.construction: unedited original training-camera surface/depth at each time, actual native compositing contribution, calibrated camera
evidence_and_holdout.edit_reference_rgb: independently generated final evaluation only; not optimization input or threshold tuning target
evidence_and_holdout.heldout: mid-time worldY+1m re-aimed camera; reuse original mid-time selection and repaired geometry, no reassociation with heldout geometry
evidence_and_holdout.temporal_scope: actual responsibility audit and editing metrics on 3 anchors only; 16-frame full audit not executed; conditional time-specific references do not establish persistent identity
evidence_and_holdout.shadow: road receiver/effect proxy separately scored; no claim body-mask selection covers all shadow or supplies pure shadow GT
evidence_and_holdout.environment: original frozen E and diagnostic constant white, same Gaussian state; save CG, alpha, E, fill, final and white
